title: Troubleshooting
summary: Fix common issues with PDF rendering, image editing, font displays, and update installation.

items.problem: Cannot edit document when Markup Toolbar is closed
items.cause: Markup tools are disabled by design while the toolbar is hidden.
solution: Click the Markup button on the top toolbar.
Or press Ctrl + Shift + A to open the Markup Toolbar.
Select your desired drawing or annotation tool.

items.problem: Crop or Rotate Selection buttons are disabled
items.cause: A selection marquee must be drawn on canvas before cropping or rotating areas.
solution: Click the Selection dropdown on the Markup Toolbar.
Choose Rectangular Selection, Oval Selection, or Lasso Selection.
Drag across the canvas to mark a region.
The Crop and Rotate Selection buttons will activate.

items.cause: Selecting Don't Save discards session modifications immediately.
solution: Always click Save or press Enter when the prompt appears.
Select File > Save or press Ctrl + S regularly while editing.
Use File > Duplicate / Save As New Copy... to preserve original copies.

items.problem: Color adjustments do not apply to PDF text
items.cause: Adjust Color modifies pixel data in raster images and photos.
solution: Use Adjust Color on image files like PNG, JPEG, and TIFF.
For PDF documents, use the Highlighter tool or Text Box styling.

items.problem: Encrypted PDF cannot be opened without password
items.cause: AES-256 PDF encryption cannot be bypassed without the key.
solution: Type the document password when prompted by Preview.
Always store backup passwords in a secure password manager.

note: If an issue persists, select Help > Check for Updates... to install the latest software patch.
